bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_LIVE_SOURCE_DELTA
'
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DIRTY_FILES_BEGIN
'; git status --short --untracked-files=all; printf 'DIRTY_FILES_END
'
printf 'PROFILE_DIFF_BEGIN
'; git diff -- artifacts/bot/src/services/profilePublicView.ts artifacts/bot/src/bot/profileViewerHandlers.ts artifacts/bot/src/services/profileRepository.ts artifacts/bot/src/services/telegramDispatcher.ts artifacts/bot/src/bot/postingHandlers.ts artifacts/bot/src/db/migrate.ts; printf 'PROFILE_DIFF_END
'
printf 'RELEVANT_HASHES_BEGIN
'
for p in artifacts/bot/src/services/profilePublicView.ts artifacts/bot/src/bot/profileViewerHandlers.ts artifacts/bot/src/services/profileRepository.ts artifacts/bot/src/services/telegramDispatcher.ts artifacts/bot/src/bot/postingHandlers.ts artifacts/bot/src/db/migrate.ts; do if test -f "$p"; then sha256sum "$p"; else printf 'ABSENT %s
' "$p"; fi; done
printf 'RELEVANT_HASHES_END
'
printf 'RUNTIME_CONTAINERS_BEGIN
'; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|tgtumbler|gateapp' || true; printf 'RUNTIME_CONTAINERS_END
'
printf 'COMPOSE_CANDIDATES_BEGIN
'; find /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' \) | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|compose|deploy' | head -n 40 || true; printf 'COMPOSE_CANDIDATES_END
'
